subject: Reschedule: Redwood demo — need time for prep and data access
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@enterprisecorp.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@enterprisecorp.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reschedule: Redwood demo — need time for prep and data access

Hi Samantha —

Quick ask: we’re currently scheduled for the full product demo on Tue, Apr 13 at 10:00 AM PT. After syncing with our solutions engineering team, we realized we need a little more time to prepare a demo that’s tailored to EnterpriseCorp’s workload (prompt sets, KV traces, and sample data ingestion). To make the session high value for your execs, can we move the demo to Thu, Apr 15 or Fri, Apr 16? That will give us time to: 

- Pull representative workload traces and prepare prompt examples against your schema
- Create a short demo dataset and validate ingestion/access (S3/GCS or secure Drive)
- Configure a few routing and quantization profiles to show cost/latency tradeoffs

I’ve attached a quick demo agenda and a prep checklist. If moving is not possible on your side, we can still run the planned session, but it’ll be more high-level.

Proposed times (PT):
- Thu, Apr 15: 9:00–10:00 or 9:30–10:30
- Fri, Apr 16: 10:00–11:00

If one of those works, I’ll confirm with our SE (David) and send an updated invite with a short runbook and the prep items. Also, could you share a 3–5 MB sample of the typical payloads (anonymized) or a schema/CSV so we can validate throughput? If you prefer, you can upload to the Drive folder linked below with reviewer access.

Drive (sample data & instructions): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-demo-prep
Calendly (alternative times): https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/enterprise-demo-30

Thanks — appreciate flexibility.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: redwood-demo-agenda.pdf, prep-checklist.md

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@enterprisecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@enterprisecorp.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reschedule: Redwood demo — need time for prep and data access

Thanks for the heads-up, Marissa. Execs are traveling on Apr 16, so we can’t do that day — Apr 15 should work for us. Morning is preferable.

We can provide a small anonymized CSV with a few examples by Mon morning. Tom will upload to the Drive folder you linked.

Suggested time: Thu, Apr 15 at 9:30 AM PT. Please confirm and include any access steps you need for our SSO/S3.

Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Data & Integrations | EnterpriseCorp
samantha.lee@enterprisecorp.com | +1 212-555-0147

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 11:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reschedule: Redwood demo — need time for prep and data access

Marissa — thanks for the heads-up. I’m available Thu Apr 15 between 8:30–11:30 AM PT and can lead the tech portion. To make the demo valuable, here are the prep tasks I’ll need before the session: 

- Confirm sample data upload (CSV or JSONL) and provide a schema mapping (column names, tokenization expectations)
- Temporary S3/GCS read access or a Drive link with reviewer permissions
- Example prompt flows or a 5–10 item prompt set we can run during the demo
- Any constraints (max sequence length, redaction rules) and a sense of RPS for production-like traces

I’ll spin up a dedicated demo environment and pre-configure a model profile and batching settings. If possible, please request the data by Mon EOD so I have Tue/Wed to run throughput tests and prepare workload traces.

Also: do we want to offer a one-week extended trial token pool as a gesture (internal approval required)? Sean — can you sign off if needed?

-David
David Kim
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@enterprisecorp.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <t.ellis@enterprisecorp.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Demo moved to Thu, Apr 15, 9:30 AM PT — prep checklist + access

Thanks Samantha — confirmed for Thu Apr 15 at 9:30 AM PT. I’ll send the updated calendar invite shortly. Agenda and prep checklist attached.

Actions for EnterpriseCorp before Wed EOD: 
- Upload anonymized sample CSV to Drive folder (link below) with reviewer access for david.kim@redwood.ai
- Share SSO/IDP test account or temporary S3 read credentials (if you want the ingestion path validated)
- Send a 5–10 item prompt set (examples of user prompts you care about)

Drive (upload here): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-demo-prep
Calendly: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/enterprise-demo-30
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/contact/8910

David will use the data to generate workload traces and validate latency/cost tradeoffs before the session. If you run into any issues uploading, reply here and I’ll loop in our solutions operations contact.

Looking forward to the demo — will include a short Q&A and next-steps slide for procurement/POs at the end.

Best,
Marissa
